scientific_integrity: The one-gap formula is credited to prior literature. Finite exhaustive checks support but do not prove the analytic asymptotics. No independent review or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform independent circle points and undirected one-nearest-neighbor graph only; threshold-indexed subsequential Poisson limits, not a continuous Gumbel law. Full texts of related 2012 and 2014 local-maximum-gap papers were inaccessible and earlier broader coverage cannot be fully ruled out.
title: Poisson rare clusters and two-point concentration in a circular nearest-neighbor forest
